d:
The Madras High Court has granted interim protection to Chennai Super Kings (CSK) fan Saravanan Hari, restraining Blinkit from commercially exploiting his distinctive appearance without consent.
The court said personality rights protection cannot be restricted to celebrities, after Hari alleged that a Blinkit advertisement reproduced his distinctive yellow-painted appearance.
